title: cairn cleanup clears the tester's seal troubles whose proof is proven or gone
intention: cairn cleanup clears the tester's seal-red-* and red-tickets-held-red-* troubles whose proof is sealed green with its fingerprint matching, or no longer exists; the tester rechecks and emits the clear, the trouble device's drain folds it.
why: Measured 2026-11-18 at the akiendelllinux house: bin/cmd/cleanup rechecks only inspector-new-finding-* (its recheck_findings step), and of 24 live troubles 9 of the tester's had a gone cause: 7 of 7 red-tickets-held-red-* name a proof validation_store.standing() reads proven, and 2 of 4 seal-red-* name a proof file that no longer exists (bin/proofs/test_retired_components_are_gone.py, cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_an_outside_proof_asks_the_inspector_through_inspect_wire.py). akienasus_cc_0's cleanup the same night cleared 1 of 16 measured-stale.
traces_to: Law 9 and Law 7: a standing trouble whose cause is gone no longer says what is. Law 6: the raiser emits, the trouble device folds (precedent 95557c2ed44f).
how: New cairn/devices/tester/recheck.py: recheck(identities, *, proof_roots=None, raiser=None) indexes proof files under proof_roots (default the repo) by cairn/tools/validation_store/validation_store.py seal_trouble_identity and by the trouble slug of 'red_tickets:held:red:<rel>' (cairn/devices/tester/red_tickets.py red_keys, _hold), longest prefix wins; for each identity it emits raiser.clear_trouble(identity, by='cc', what_changed=<which predicate held>) when no proof matches or standing(proof)['proven'] is True, else reports it standing; an identity of neither kind is reported unknown. raiser defaults to ModuleRaiser('tester'). cairn/devices/tester/cli.py gains --recheck-troubles IDS... printing the result as json; bin/cmd/cleanup gains step 'seals' before 'troubles', handing it the live seal-red-*/red-tickets-held-red-* ids as recheck_findings does, and its --summarize reads the counts.

clauses.claim: a seal-red trouble for a proof that standing() reads proven is cleared by recheck and the drain
a seal-red trouble naming no proof file is cleared by recheck and the drain
a seal-red trouble for an existing proof never sealed stays OPEN and is reported standing
a red-tickets-held-red trouble for a proven proof is cleared by recheck and the drain
a red-tickets-held-red trouble for an existing proof never sealed stays OPEN

decisions.text: D1: the recheck lives at cairn/devices/tester/recheck.py with the raiser; the tester never writes the trouble store, it emits clear_trouble.
D2: the proof is recovered from the identity alone (live records carry no detail); the proven predicate is validation_store.standing, never a re-read of the seal.
D3: cairn/devices/tester/cli.py --recheck-troubles; bin/cmd/cleanup step 'seals' runs before 'troubles'.

D5: bin/cmd/cleanup reaches the tester only through its CLI, "$CAIRN" test --recheck-troubles <ids> as a subprocess, never by importing cairn.devices.tester.recheck: bin is inspected by the build gate (since c1c3), and an import of another device's code reds encapsulation_holds (RULE 1).
D4: the proof raises the five troubles in a scratch world, drains a scratch store through TroubleShim, and passes proof_roots=[repo, scratch] so a never-sealed proof lives in scratch.

measured.saw: bin/cmd/cleanup's only recheck hands inspector --recheck the inspector-new-finding-* ids
24 live; red-tickets-held-red 7/7 proven; seal-red 2/4 proof gone, 2/4 red; ticket-unqueued/refused 1/9 terminal
measured.how: bin/cairn trouble live --json, then per trouble validation_store.standing() / proof index by seal_trouble_identity / ticket workflow_and_state (scratch measure.py)

orient.request: cairn cleanup clears the tester's seal-red and red-tickets-held-red troubles whose proof is proven or gone
orient.intent: bin/cmd/cleanup gains a 'seals' step before the drain: it hands the live seal-red-* and red-tickets-held-red-* trouble ids to the tester's CLI (cairn test --recheck-troubles), and the tester's new recheck module emits clear_trouble for each whose proof validation_store.standing() reads proven or whose proof file no longer exists; the trouble drain folds the clears.
orient.scope: IN: cairn/devices/tester/recheck.py, cairn/devices/tester/cli.py, bin/cmd/cleanup, the proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_cleanup_rechecks_the_testers_seal_troubles.py. OUT: cairn/tools/validation_store/validation_store.py and cairn/devices/tester/red_tickets.py (read, unchanged), cairn/devices/trouble (folds, unchanged), the ticket-unqueued/refused kinds (sibling ticket), red-tickets-outline-check-*.

constraints.text: the tester emits clear_trouble; it never writes the trouble store, and the drain folds (Law 6, precedent 95557c2ed44f)
the proven predicate is validation_store.standing, and the proof is recovered from the identity alone
bin/cmd/cleanup reaches the tester only through its CLI as a subprocess, never by importing its code (RULE 1, encapsulation_holds)
